description: Ground truth dataset for LLM-as-Judge evaluation. Each incident class has 3 variants paired for memory improvement testing.

incident_classes.root_cause_pattern: Computational resource exhaustion from unbounded/inefficient processing
incident_classes.resolution_pattern: Identify and bound the runaway computation, deploy fix, add guards

alert.description: Inventory service CPU at 94% sustained. Stock level calculations hanging.

ground_truth.root_cause: Recursive stock aggregation query with no depth limit triggered by circular warehouse dependency in configuration
ground_truth.resolution: Added max recursion depth of 10 to stock aggregation. Fixed circular dependency in warehouse config. Restarted service.

alert.description: Pricing engine CPU at 91% sustained. Dynamic pricing calculations unresponsive.

ground_truth.root_cause: Recursive bundle pricing calculation with no depth limit triggered by circular product bundle reference
ground_truth.resolution: Added max recursion depth of 5 to bundle pricing. Fixed circular bundle reference in product catalog. Restarted service.

alert.description: Report generator CPU at 88%. Monthly report generation consuming all available compute.

ground_truth.root_cause: Monthly batch spawned 50 parallel PDF renders without concurrency limit, each holding large data in memory
ground_truth.resolution: Added semaphore limiting concurrent renders to 10. Implemented streaming PDF generation to reduce per-report memory. Staggered batch start times.

incident_classes.root_cause_pattern: Resource retention without proper cleanup or bounded lifecycle
incident_classes.resolution_pattern: Add TTL/bounds to resource pools, fix reference retention, add monitoring

alert.description: WebSocket gateway memory at 92% and growing. Connected clients experiencing disconnects.

ground_truth.root_cause: WebSocket session objects retained in memory after client disconnect. Cleanup callback not firing on abnormal close.
ground_truth.resolution: Fixed disconnect handler to cover all close codes. Added periodic sweep (every 60s) to remove sessions idle >5min. Set max session lifetime of 24hr.

alert.description: Server-Sent Events service memory at 89%. Event subscribers not being cleaned up.

ground_truth.root_cause: SSE channel objects not removed when subscriber disconnects. Unsubscribe event not propagated on network timeout.
ground_truth.resolution: Added heartbeat-based liveness check every 30s. Channels with no active subscriber for >2min are reaped. Set max channels per service to 10000.

alert.description: File processor memory growing steadily. Large file handles not being released after processing.

ground_truth.root_cause: File processing pipeline not closing file handles in error path. When processing fails, temp files and handles leak.
ground_truth.resolution: Wrapped file operations in try/finally to guarantee handle closure. Added temp file cleanup on error. Implemented file handle pool with max 100 concurrent.

incident_classes.root_cause_pattern: Connectivity loss between components causing split-brain or unavailability
incident_classes.resolution_pattern: Restore connectivity, verify data consistency, add partition detection

alert.description: Distributed lock service split. Two leaders elected simultaneously across partitions.

ground_truth.root_cause: Security group update dropped traffic between subnet-A and subnet-B. Leader election quorum too low (2/3 instead of 3/5).
ground_truth.resolution: Reverted security group change. Increased quorum requirement to 3/5. Added fencing token to prevent stale leader actions. Reconciled conflicting locks.

alert.description: Config service cluster partitioned. Different nodes serving different config versions.

ground_truth.root_cause: Firewall rule update blocked internal cluster traffic between config service nodes in different AZs.
ground_truth.resolution: Reverted firewall rule change. Added change validation for internal cluster ports. Forced config re-sync from primary. Added version consistency health check.

alert.description: Message queue cluster experiencing intermittent connectivity. Messages being duplicated.

ground_truth.root_cause: Intermittent MTU mismatch on new VXLAN overlay network causing large packets to be dropped between queue nodes
ground_truth.resolution: Configured consistent MTU 1400 across VXLAN overlay. Enabled TCP MSS clamping. Added idempotency keys to consumers to handle duplicate messages.

incident_classes.root_cause_pattern: Storage bandwidth exhaustion from unbounded writes or competing workloads
incident_classes.resolution_pattern: Identify and throttle the I/O source, separate workloads, upgrade storage tier

alert.description: TimeSeries DB write latency 100x normal. Compaction unable to keep up with ingest rate.

ground_truth.root_cause: New metrics collection agent deployed across fleet doubled ingest rate without pre-provisioned compaction capacity
ground_truth.resolution: Temporarily throttled new metrics agent to 50% rate. Increased compaction concurrency from 4 to 8. Upgraded to io2 Block Express volumes. Gradually restored full ingest.

alert.description: Audit log store write latency spiked. Compliance logs being buffered and at risk of loss.

ground_truth.root_cause: Compliance audit expansion tripled write volume overnight without corresponding storage capacity increase
ground_truth.resolution: Increased compaction threads from 2 to 6. Added write rate limiter with backpressure signal to producers. Upgraded storage to provisioned IOPS. Phased audit expansion.

alert.description: Object store proxy disk I/O saturated from cache warming after restart.

ground_truth.root_cause: Cache warming strategy attempts to preload all 2M objects simultaneously after pod restart, saturating disk
ground_truth.resolution: Implemented gradual cache warming (1000 objects/s). Added priority-based warming (hot objects first via access frequency). Served requests with origin fallback during warm-up.

incident_classes.root_cause_pattern: Single component failure propagating through dependency chain due to missing isolation
incident_classes.resolution_pattern: Isolate failure domain, add circuit breakers, implement graceful degradation

alert.description: Booking platform cascade: availability check timeout caused search failures, which overwhelmed fallback service.

ground_truth.root_cause: Slow database query in availability service (missing index) caused timeout cascade. Fallback service not provisioned for full traffic load.
ground_truth.resolution: Added missing index on availability table. Set aggressive timeout (2s) on availability calls. Provisioned fallback service to handle 100% traffic. Added circuit breaker with 50% error threshold.

alert.description: Shipping platform cascade: rate calculator timeout caused order completion failures, backing up the entire fulfillment queue.

ground_truth.root_cause: External carrier API timeout (provider outage) caused request pile-up. No circuit breaker or timeout cap on rate calculation. Fulfillment queue not bounded.
ground_truth.resolution: Added 3s timeout on carrier API calls. Implemented circuit breaker (opens after 5 failures in 10s). Added cached rates as fallback. Set fulfillment queue max with backpressure.

alert.description: Media pipeline cascade: transcoding service OOM caused upload failures, which filled local disk on ingest service.

ground_truth.root_cause: 4K video transcoding request exceeded memory limit. Upload service buffers locally without limit when transcoder unavailable. Fills disk on ingest service.
ground_truth.resolution: Added memory limit per transcode job (4GB max, reject larger). Bounded local upload buffer to 10GB with rejection when full. Added async processing queue between upload and transcode.

evaluation_metadata.expected_improvement: memory_assisted variants should score >= 0.5 higher than first_encounter on same class
